subject: Control System

Q
11. Consider the following statements: 
 
1. 
The derivative control improves the overshoots 
of a given system. 
 
2. 
The derivative control reduces steady state 
error. 
 
3. 
Integral control reduces steady-state error. 
 
4. 
Integral control does not affect stability of the 
system. 
 
5. 
Integral control improves the overshoot of the 
system. 
 
Of these statements 
 
(a) 1 & 3 are correct 
 
 
(b) 1, 2 & 5 are correct 
 
(c) 2,4 & 5 are correct 
 
(d) 1, 3 & 5 are correct 
 
MCQ 
 
        
 
EASY
explanation: Practice Question from Control System DPP-24 (Designing of Compensator).
